origin: Authored in this repository for the M8 LTspice grammar
author: xdylanm
notes: Each fixture is one malformed or unsupported construct; line and column are 1-based. 'error' is ParseError or UnsupportedConstruct. The notes quote LTspice 26.1.1 where it stops at the same construct.

bare_formula.cir.note: unbraced expression in a value slot

bare_name_value.cir.note: a bare name is a model in LTspice, and R takes none

flag_with_a_word.cir.note: a flag's value is a number or a formula

frequency_analyzer.cir.note: fmin= is not a parameter of the frequency response analyzer (LTspice stops)

not_a_letter.cir.note: N is not an LTspice letter

source_after_ac.cir.note: the reference's order: AC before Rser

type_on_inductor.cir.note: type is a C parameter; LTspice stops at it on L and R

unset_gain.net.note: LTspice's export of an E symbol whose gain was never set; LTspice stops with Unknown parameter (decision 0015 items 6 and 12). Written for M14 from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

f_m.cir.note: m= is not an LTspice F parameter; LTspice stops (decision 0015 item 7). Written for M14 from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

s_on_off.cir.note: on and off together; LTspice runs it and the last wins (decision 0015 item 8). Written for M14 from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

b_v_and_i.cir.note: A B source takes one of V=, I=, R= and P=; LTspice stops (decision 0016 item 3). Written for M15 from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

b_no_expression.cir.note: A B source needs V=, I=, R= or P=; LTspice stops. Written for M15 from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

e_vol.cir.note: ngspice's vol=; LTspice stops (decision 0016 item 9). Written for M15 from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

e_table_braces.cir.note: ngspice's TABLE form, which LTspice runs but its reference does not show (decision 0016 item 9). Written for M15 from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

e_value_node.cir.note: value after E's output nodes is the expression form's keyword, not a node; LTspice stops (decision 0016 item 9). Written for M15 review R2 from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

f_value_source.cir.note: value after F's output nodes is the expression form's keyword, not the controlling source; LTspice runs it as value=2.2 (decision 0016 item 9). Written for M15 review R2 from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

e_table_pairs.cir.note: Table= with pairs in their own parentheses; LTspice stops (decision 0017 item 4). Written for M15b from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

e_table_odd.cir.note: Table= with an odd count; LTspice stops ("Pairs of numbers expected"). Written for M15b from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

e_laplace_read.cir.note: A V() in Laplace=; LTspice stops ("Voltage reference not allowed here"). Written for M15b from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

e_laplace_unknown_param.cir.note: An unknown parameter after Laplace=; LTspice stops. Written for M15b from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

e_poly_dimension.cir.note: POLY with a braced dimension; LTspice runs it, but the dimension decides the topology (decision 0017 item 3). Written for M15b from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

f_poly_paren.cir.note: A controlling source in parentheses; LTspice stops. Written for M15b from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

b_laplace_resistor.cir.note: Laplace= on R=; LTspice runs it, but its reference shows it on V= and I= only (decision 0017 item 4). Written for M15b from the maintainer's controlled_sources examples.

t_f_nl.cir.note: F= and NL= run, the reference lists Td=

t_ic.cir.note: IC= runs, the reference does not list it

t_no_length.cir.note: T without Td= (LTspice uses a default delay)

a_inv_name.cir.note: INV is a symbol, not a special function name (LTspice stops)

a_bare_param.cir.note: a bare name in an A parameter's value (LTspice runs it)

a_seven_nodes.cir.note: an A line with seven nodes (LTspice stops)

fra_unknown_param.cir.note: a parameter the analyzer does not take (LTspice stops)

a_param_comma.cir.note: a comma between an A line's parameters (LTspice runs it; decision 0009)

fra_param_comma.cir.note: a comma between an @ line's parameters (LTspice runs it; decision 0009)

probe_param.cir.note: a parameter on an & line (LTspice stops)

plus_comment_last_line.cir.note: a + line that holds only a comment ends the statement (LTspice stops: Syntax error; M18 D2)

x_params_comma.cir.note: a comma right after params: on X (LTspice stops: syntax error; M18 D2)
